groom-mane-brush.name: Mane & Tail Brush
groom-mane-brush.description: A pastel paddle brush (Grooming mod). Stroke a pony's mane or tail with it; on desktop look at her mane or tail and hold the mouse button.

groom-coat-brush.name: Coat Brush
groom-coat-brush.description: A soft pastel body brush (Grooming mod). Stroke a pony's coat with it; on desktop look at her coat and hold the mouse button.
